# 404_@林达

> 404_@林达 的个人项目与开发笔记，重点记录本地开发工具、AI 运维、PR 证据检查、Three.js 作品集、数据可视化和全栈实践。

Main site: https://linsk27.github.io/
GitHub profile: https://github.com/linsk27
Project hub: https://linsk27.github.io/projects/
GitHub projects index: https://linsk27.github.io/github/
About page: https://linsk27.github.io/about/

## Maintained projects

- Dev Cockpit: local development workbench for detecting stacks, commands, ports, Python environments, Git state, runtime status, and restoring project context. Project page: https://linsk27.github.io/projects/dev-cockpit/ Repository: https://github.com/linsk-labs/local-dev-cockpit
- Local AI Ops: local-first Alibaba Cloud ops console for asset sync, monitoring checks, alert workflow, and optional redacted troubleshooting suggestions. Project page: https://linsk27.github.io/projects/local-ai-ops/ Repository: https://github.com/linsk-labs/local-ai-ops
- ProofPR: deterministic GitHub Action and CLI for pull request evidence checks, dependency signals, workflow permissions, secrets, MCP configuration, and review gates. It does not call an LLM at runtime. Project page: https://linsk27.github.io/projects/proofpr/ Repository: https://github.com/linsk-labs/proof-pr
- Signal Atlas: immersive Three.js workstation with a live CSS3D monitor, an original linsk27 desktop, real content routes, and licensed attribution for the MIT upstream outer scene. Project page: https://linsk27.github.io/projects/signal-atlas/ Repository: https://github.com/linsk-labs/signal-atlas Demo: https://linsk27.dpdns.org/

## Other public work

- AI-Vue3-python-flask-Blog: Vue 3, Flask, MySQL and AI blog system for full-stack practice and secondary development. Project page: https://linsk27.github.io/projects/ai-vue-flask-blog/ Repository: https://github.com/linsk27/AI-Vue3-python-flask-Blog Demo: https://ai-vue3-python-flask-blog.vercel.app/
- feidu: Nuxt 3, Vue, Tailwind CSS and ECharts smart-community dashboard. Project page: https://linsk27.github.io/projects/feidu/ Repository: https://github.com/linsk27/feidu Demo: https://feidu-murex.vercel.app
- echarts-learn: Vue, Nuxt and ECharts dashboard practice. Project page: https://linsk27.github.io/projects/echarts-learn/ Repository: https://github.com/linsk27/echarts-learn
- bilibili-nuxt3: Nuxt 3, Vue, TypeScript and Vant mobile project practice. Project page: https://linsk27.github.io/projects/bilibili-nuxt3/ Repository: https://github.com/linsk27/bilibili-nuxt3

## Third-party open-source tools

- Archify by tt-a1i: MIT-licensed Agent skill that turns natural language or repository evidence into validated technical diagrams through typed JSON IR and HTML/SVG rendering. This is an external project, not a linsk27 repository. Website: https://tt-a1i.github.io/archify/ Repository: https://github.com/tt-a1i/archify

## Topics

Vue, TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Nuxt, Node.js, Vite, Electron, Three.js, CSS3DRenderer, WebGL, GitHub Actions, deterministic PR review, FastAPI, Python, PostgreSQL, Redis, Celery, Alibaba Cloud, Flask, MySQL, ECharts, local-first developer tools, DNS, Cloudflare.
